    "Significantly easier to set up and manage compared to WooCommerce.",

    "Excellent for managing sales and receiving instant payment notifications."

  "cons": [
    "Monthly fees and transaction costs can add up over time.",
    "Limited customization options without delving into code or expensive apps.",
    "Reliance on third-party apps for some essential features."
  ],
  "overall_experience": "This self-employed owner likely found Shopify to be a significant upgrade in terms of ease of use and reduced technical burden compared to their previous experience with WooCommerce. The platform efficiently handles core online business management and provides reliable sales notifications, allowing them to focus on growth. While appreciating its simplicity, they may have noted that the cumulative costs of subscriptions and apps could become a concern after two years of operation."
